## Findings

- **AC-5.3 REFUTED.** The criterion as corrected at A-orch.18 has two clauses. Only the memory clause has a row. The busy clause, "an unknown busy reading counts every promise whole", fails when "a promise is faded on an unknown busy reading". No case reaches that condition: H.8 plants busy 1.0 (tests/gate.test.sh:550-557), and `world_machine` refuses a non-numeric busy (tests/lib/world.sh:114-115). `/usr/bin/grep -rl _gate_faded tests/` returns only tests/CENSUS.md. A-T2.3 says so in its own words: "no row asserts the busy clause". The `num(busy)` condition in `_gate_faded` (payload/scripts/lib/gate.sh:758-765) is new in this wave, and no test fails when it is inverted. The row is discharged on an eval, H.8 and H.9, that cannot reach the clause.

## The three places weighed

- **The inverted pins at T2.** H.4 and WA.3 were inverted in place. Main says `admitted (rc 0)` and `answered 1` (`git show 59350b5e6:tests/gate.test.sh` lines 332 and 527); the head says rc 75 and answered 0. Both were red before the change at 11d89fdd (scratch/w49-T2/gate-red.log `FAIL: WA.3`, `FAIL: H.4`, `FAIL: H.5`), so each carries a red-first proof and not only a green after. H.8 was not inverted: main and head carry the same text, "memory unreadable (-1), nothing admitted: admitted". That is right under the corrected AC-5.3. The spec's D12 still reads "H.4, H.8 and WA.3 are inverted in place", which is stale text. T2's red ran against a draft (172 cases, LO.1-LO.4, RM.1-RM.4). The landed §LONE and §ROOM were reshaped after it (A-T2.10) and not re-run at main. Their red holds structurally, because main admits the first ask at load 16 and sums the room's promises whole.
- **The re-pins born of the design.** Each re-pin is a fixture meeting the new law, not a test bent to pass. stop GAP2 and GAP3 moved from 7.0 to 6.0: the property is the same one-writer room as 7.0 under 7.36, now under 6.36, and they were red at a4a4a48 (scratch/w49-T7/base-stop.log `FAIL: GAP2a`). runner-width plants reserve 0 once, and its new case 6i pins the default reserve. 6i's mutant is red on 6i alone (scratch/w49-T16/mutant.log 47/48), and the ten reds it cleared are in scratch/w49-T16/red.log. landing-line-2 plants reserve 0 and moves its width numbers with the alignment ruling, each moved number named in A-T2.7. Its reds are in scratch/w49-T2/ll2-1.log, its green at head is in the whole run (log line 72), and only that file's arithmetic is unverified here. DC.0 moved from busy 6.0 to 3.0. It was red at 7a92d2337 independently of T5: cost-blast.log line 117 reads `FAIL: DC.0`. The new numbers keep the section's claim, since 3.0 + 1.61 fits 5.4 and a second 1.61 does not. T5's own cited head log (`T5-head.log`, A-T5.4) is not on disk, because T5's scratch directory is empty, and the blast stands in for it.
- **The corrected plants.** AC-3.2's plant of 5.8, 6.0 and 13.0 still fails on each failure the criterion names. The first plant could not separate the rule from the largest. The corrected plant cannot separate the rule from a plain median, and that gap is recorded in the row and does not block. AC-5.3's correction is honest about the memory clause but left its new busy clause unproven: REFUTED, above. AC-2.1 and AC-3.3, corrected at A-orch.19, are pinned by CL.1, which tells the free room (4) from both the suite constant and the width (6), and by GR.1 through the runner cap's mutant. The plan block's AC-2.1 statement line still says `kind=whole`.

## Notes, not verdicts

- **Missing red logs.** T4 saved no red log; its progress file records "cmd-class 9 failed, background-suite-guard 3 failed". T5's scratch directory is empty. For each row involved, a static read of the base files shows the case could not pass before the change, and that read is cited in the row.
- **Stale plan text.** The plan's Verification Matrix table carries `—` in every evidence cell, while each AC block's `evidence:` line names its log. Several eval texts trail their fixtures: AC-2.2 says width 7 where the fixture has 6, and AC-4.1 and AC-4.2 say share 92 where the fixture has share 80 (A-T2.2). AC-1.3's evidence line should add line/T5-booked-68ef6f335083.log.
- **The blasts missed two suites.** session-poker-5 and slots were last measured at 11d89fdd and a4a4a48 in reserve-blast.log. The cost blast at 7a92d2337 did not include them. Their reds surfaced only in the whole run, after T2's width-ask alignment and T3's promise.
- **Static rows.** AC-2.3, AC-7.1, AC-7.2 and AC-7.3 are pending by design. They are owed by the doc row T12 and the close row T14 at their steps, so a pending reading there is not a finding.
